story.title: Mazaq means taste.
story.lead: We started with one espresso machine on 26th of July Street in Zamalek and a belief that Egypt deserved coffee roasted at home, with care.
story.p1: Today we roast every week in 6th of October City and serve from Cairo to London. The menu has grown, but the rule hasn’t changed: start with good green coffee, roast it to taste like where it came from, and serve it quickly and kindly.
story.p2: Our cafés borrow their arches from Cairene architecture and their colours from the Nile. Our menu borrows from home too: Turkish coffee with cardamom, dates, tahini, Sidr honey and saffron.
story.v1: Every bean is roasted in Egypt, weekly, in small batches.
story.v2: We buy from named farms and cooperatives and publish altitude, process and varietal on every bag.
story.v3: Calories, protein and allergens are listed for every item, in store and in the app.

sourcing.title: From the farm to your cup.
sourcing.lead: We buy green coffee from six origins, travel to see it grown, and pay above Fairtrade minimums for the lots we keep.
sourcing.p1: Every lot is cupped in our Cairo lab before we buy it and again after each roast. We look for sweetness, clarity and a sense of place.
sourcing.p2: We publish region, altitude, process and varietal for every coffee we sell. Where we can, we name the farm or washing station.

corporate.title: Coffee for the whole team.
corporate.lead: Office coffee boxes, meeting catering and bean subscriptions for teams of 5 to 5,000. Tell us what you need and we’ll send a proposal within one working day.

franchise.title: Bring Mazaq to your city.
franchise.lead: We partner with operators who care about hospitality as much as coffee. We provide the brand, the roastery, training and our app; you bring the city.
points: Full barista training at our Cairo academy
Weekly roasted coffee supply and quality checks

contact.title: We’re listening.

allergens.title: What’s in everything we serve.
allergens.lead: Calories are for the Regular size with full-cream milk unless stated. Our kitchens handle all major allergens, so we can’t guarantee any item is allergen-free.
allergens.note: Working values — being confirmed with a nutritionist before launch.

sections.p: Your name, phone number, email, order history and rewards balance. We never store full card numbers.
To take and prepare your orders, run Mazaq Rewards, and — only if you agree — tell you about new drinks and offers.
Payment processors and delivery partners, only to complete your order. We don’t sell personal data.
You can see, correct or delete your data at any time from the app or by emailing privacy@mazaq.coffee.
Order-ahead orders are prepared for the time you choose. Please collect within 30 minutes of the ready time.
Prices include VAT and may vary by market and store. The price shown at checkout is the price you pay.
Beans have no cash value and can’t be transferred. We may change reward tiers with 30 days’ notice.
Delivery is available for coffee beans only, within our delivery areas.
